page.overview:
Who is Thalvus Agyomenidus?

Thalvus Agyomenidus was a woodworker from Coruscant's 1649th level who was involved with the 4040s, an Imperial activist group. In an assassination attempt on Chandrilan Imperial Senator Mon Mothma, Agyomenidus killed Mothma's aide Zhuna.

Thalvus Agyomenidus was raised on Coruscant without a father. After running cargo off-world for six years, he returned to Coruscant and opened a furniture shop.

During the Clone Wars, Agyomenidus became obsessed with Republic Senator Mon Mothma, whom he saw as representing everything corrupt and unprincipled within the Republic.

After the war's end, Agyomenidus joined a radical political group called the 4040s, who were extremely supportive of Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine. When Senator Mothma failed to commit her loyalty to Emperor Palpatine, he broke into Mothma's apartment with the intention of killing her and her husband, Perrin Fertha.
